preconditions.description: The length of the array n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The input array a has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i] <= i + 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a_i satisfies 0 <= a_i <= i (using 0-based indexing for the array, so a[i] <= i+1).

preconditions.expression: all(a[i] <= a[i+1] for i in range(n - 1))

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(0 <= x <= 1000000 for x in b) and all(mex(b[:i+1]) == a[i] for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a sequence of n integers b where each b_i is between 0 and 10^6, and for every index i, the MEX of the prefix b[0...i] equals a[i].
